title: Zero-Sum Power Factor Games
summary: Variable active power injections arising from device behavior or compromised dispatch complicate voltage regulation in electric power networks with distributed energy resources (DERs). An operator can limit the resulting voltage deviations by remotely selecting DER reactive power parameters before observing the active power injections. IEEE Standard 1547-2018 specifies constant power factor as one such control mode, coupling each device's reactive power to its realized active power.
